        problem: r`**Problem-based learning:** quantities from daily life (a debt of GH₵ 40, a diver at $-18$ m, temperatures, a bank calculation) decide which number set is needed.`,
        talk: r`**Talk for Learning (think–pair–share):** learners classify alone, compare with a partner, then agree in the group before reporting; diamond nine for rational and irrational decimals.`,
        collab: r`**Group work / collaborative learning:** ${ctx.groups} for the card sort, the closure table and the daily-life task, with rotating roles.`,
        experiential: r`**Experiential learning:** a human number line for Worked Example 1.5; constructing $\sqrt{2}$ on the number line with a unit square; long division to see decimals terminate or recur.`,
        inquiry: r`**Inquiry:** learners test closure claims and search for counterexamples (Worked Example 1.4).`,
        game: r`**Gamification:** team points in the Lesson 1 recap quiz.`,
        reflect: r`**Reflective practice:** exit tickets in both lessons and the ${lm} checklist at the end of the week.`
      };
      const items = Object.keys(STRATEGIES).filter(k => ctx.st(k)).map(k => S[k]);
      return [B.ul(items.length ? items : [S.talk]), B.p('**Values and skills:** critical thinking, communication and collaboration; honesty and respect when a classmate’s counterexample disproves your claim.', { before: 3 })];
    },

    resources: ctx => {
      const it = [
        r`Teacher Manual (Year One, Section 1, Week 1) and the ${lm} Week 1 notes${ctx.has('material') ? ' (copies for learners)' : ' (teacher’s copy; key examples written on the board)'}`,
        ctx.has('projector') ? 'Projector and laptop showing the nested-sets diagram and the number line' : (ctx.has('manila') ? r`Manila chart of the nested-sets diagram ($\mathbb{N}\subset W\subset\mathbb{Z}\subset\mathbb{Q}\subset\mathbb{R}$, irrationals beside $\mathbb{Q}$)` : 'Nested-sets diagram drawn on the board before the lesson'),
        `${ctx.G} sets of ${ctx.cards} for Worked Example 1.1 (Lesson 1) and a set of five large cards for Worked Example 1.5 (Lesson 2)`,
        'Prompt cards with the three classifying questions (for AP groups)',
        ctx.has('tape') ? r`Masking tape or chalk for a floor number line from $-3$ to $2$` : 'A large number line drawn along the board',
        ctx.has('calculators') ? 'Calculators (to check long division)' : null,
        ctx.has('slates') ? 'Mini whiteboards or slates and markers' : 'Jotters or scrap paper for “show-me” answers',
        ctx.has('sticky') ? 'Sticky notes for individual answers' : null,
        ctx.digital ? 'GeoGebra (number line) on phones or the projector' : null,
        ctx.has('maths_set') ? 'Mathematical sets: rulers and compasses for the closure table, number lines and the $\\sqrt{2}$ construction' : 'Rulers or straight edges and a piece of string for the $\\sqrt{2}$ construction',
        'Nine diamond-nine cards per group (Lesson 1, Activity 3)',
        ctx.need('visual') ? `Large-print cards${ctx.has('tactile') ? ' and tactile materials (string, glue, beads) for a raised number line' : ''}` : null
      ];
      return [B.ul(it)];
    },

    differentiation: (ctx, lessons) => {
      const out = [];
      const b = ctx.band;
      out.push(B.p(`**Class profile.** ${ctx.n} learners${ctx.single ? ` (all ${ctx.single})` : ` (${ctx.boys} boys, ${ctx.girls} girls)`}, ${ctx.progName}. ` + (b.known
        ? `${b.source === 'score' ? `Readiness estimated from the last test average (${b.score}%)` : 'Expected readiness'}: about **${b.ap} approaching proficiency (AP)**, **${b.p} proficient (P)** and **${b.hp} highly proficient (HP)**. Confirm with the Lesson 1 starter and the exit tickets.`
        : 'Readiness is not yet known: use the Lesson 1 starter and the Activity 1 board answers as a diagnostic, then form readiness groups from the Lesson 1 exit ticket.')));
      const gtxt = [`**Grouping.** Exploration tasks use ${ctx.groups}`];
      if (b.known && b.hp) gtxt.push(`, each with ${ctx.perGroup.hp} HP learner${ctx.perGroup.hp === '1' ? '' : 's'} as explainer${ctx.perGroup.hp === '1' ? '' : 's'}`);
      if (!ctx.single) gtxt.push(` and about ${ctx.perGroup.girls} girls and ${ctx.perGroup.boys} boys per group`);
      gtxt.push('. Practice tasks use readiness groups (AP, P, HP). Roles (leader, recorder, checker, timekeeper, reporter) rotate every lesson.');
      out.push(B.p(gtxt.join('')));
      if (ctx.G <= 14 && ctx.G > 1) {
        const gp = ctx.groupPlan;
        const head = ['Group', 'Learners', ...(ctx.single ? [] : ['Girls', 'Boys']), ...(b.known ? ['HP', 'P', 'AP'] : []), 'Seating and support'];
        const w = ctx.single ? (b.known ? [10, 11, 9, 9, 9, 52] : [12, 13, 75]) : (b.known ? [9, 10, 8, 8, 7, 7, 7, 44] : [11, 12, 10, 10, 57]);
        out.push(B.p('**Group plan** (mixed-ability groups for exploration; front groups sit nearest the board):', { size: 9.5, before: 2 }));
        out.push(B.table({
          cols: w, fill: 'F2CEED', small: true, head,
          rows: gp.map(r => [String(r.g), String(r.size), ...(ctx.single ? [] : [String(r.girls), String(r.boys)]), ...(b.known ? [String(r.hp), String(r.p), String(r.ap)] : []),
            [r.front ? 'Front' : '', r.notes.length ? r.notes.join('; ') : ''].filter(Boolean).join(': ') || '–'])
        }));
      }
      // gender
      if (ctx.single) out.push(B.p(`**Gender.** A single-sex class: still rotate roles so that every learner leads and reports once during the week, and use examples from both girls’ and boys’ daily lives.`));
      else if (ctx.paired) out.push(B.p(`**Gender balance.** ${ctx.paired.who === 'girls' ? 'Girls' : 'Boys'} are a minority (${ctx.paired.who === 'girls' ? ctx.girls : ctx.boys} of ${ctx.n}), so they sit at least two to a group in ${ctx.paired.mixed} of the ${ctx.paired.groups} groups: nobody is the only ${ctx.paired.who === 'girls' ? 'girl' : 'boy'} in a group. ${ctx.paired.who === 'girls' ? 'Girls' : 'Boys'} report first in alternate activities, and questions go to girls and boys equally.`));
      else if (ctx.girlShare < 0.4) out.push(B.p(`**Gender balance.** Girls are a minority (${Math.round(ctx.girlShare * 100)}%): no group has only one girl, girls report first in alternate activities, and questions go to girls and boys equally.`));
      else if (ctx.girlShare > 0.6) out.push(B.p(`**Gender balance.** Boys are a minority (${Math.round((1 - ctx.girlShare) * 100)}%): no group has only one boy, and questions and reporting are shared equally.`));
      else out.push(B.p('**Gender balance.** The class is balanced: girls and boys share the leader and reporter roles equally, and questions go to both in turn.'));
      if (ctx.large) out.push(B.p(`**Large class (${ctx.n}).** Number the groups and the roles; group leaders collect and return cards; use a clap or hand signal for attention; mark exit tickets by sampling one group per lesson and the rest by peer marking.`));
      if (!ctx.movable) out.push(B.p('**Fixed benches.** Pairs work with their bench partner; for group tasks two benches turn to face each other.'));
      // the three-band table
      const col = (band) => {
        const items = [];
        lessons.forEach((x, i) => {
          for (const ph of ['main']) for (const it of x.timing[ph].items) if (it.tiers) {
            const t = it.tiers(ctx)[band];
            items.push(`**Lesson ${i + 1}, ${it.title.split(' – ')[0]}:** ${t[0]}`);
          }
        });
        return items;
      };
      out.push(B.table({
        cols: [33, 34, 33], fill: 'F2CEED',
        head: [`Approaching proficiency (AP)${b.known ? ` – about ${b.ap}` : ''}`, `Proficient (P)${b.known ? ` – about ${b.p}` : ''}`, `Highly proficient (HP)${b.known ? ` – about ${b.hp}` : ''}`],
        sub: ['Not yet secure with JHS fractions, decimals and negative numbers', 'Secure with fractions, decimals and integers', 'Grasp ideas quickly and need challenge'],
        rows: [[
          [B.p('**Support:** prompt card with the three classifying questions; simpler cards first; partly completed closure table; teacher sits with this group at the start of each practice; peer buddy.', { size: 9 }), B.ul(col('ap'), { size: 9 })],
          [B.p('**Core:** full card sort with reasons; complete closure table with counterexamples; Exercise questions from the ' + lm + '.', { size: 9 }), B.ul(col('p'), { size: 9 })],
          [B.p('**Challenge:** explain to others; Worked Example 1.7; irrational numbers and closure; the √2 proof (Notes enrichment).', { size: 9 }), B.ul(col('hp'), { size: 9 })]
        ]]
      }));
      // SEN / GESI
      const SEN = {
        visual: `**Low vision / visual impairment${ctx.count('visual') ? ` (${ctx.count('visual')})` : ''}:** seat in the front groups; large-print cards (24 pt and above) and a bold, high-contrast board; read every number and symbol aloud (“root two”, “nought point three six recurring”); describe each diagram${ctx.has('tactile') ? '; tactile number line and string-loop set diagram' : ''}.`,
        hearing: `**Hearing impairment${ctx.count('hearing') ? ` (${ctx.count('hearing')})` : ''}:** seat in the front groups facing the teacher; write instructions, key words and answers on the board; face the class when speaking; use gestures and agreed signals; check understanding through written answers; assign a note-taking buddy.`,
        physical: '**Physical / motor disability:** keep the aisles clear; bring the group task to the learner’s desk; desk version of the number line; a partner moves cards or writes on request.',
        reading: '**Reading difficulty:** key-word wall with symbol and example; read word problems aloud; keep cards to numbers only; allow oral answers; extra time on the exit ticket.',
        attention: '**Attention difficulty:** short tasks with visible time limits; active roles (card distributor, timekeeper); seat away from the door and windows; a step checklist to tick.',
        language: `**Limited English:** pre-teach key words (natural, whole, integer, rational, irrational, recurring, closure, counterexample) with symbols; sentence frames; bilingual buddy${ctx.lang ? `; explanations may start in ${ctx.lang}` : '; explanations may start in a familiar Ghanaian language'}.`,
        shy: '**Shy or quiet learners:** think–pair–share before whole-class answers; answers on boards or sticky notes; give them the recorder role before the reporter role; praise effort and reasoning.',
        gifted: '**Gifted and talented:** HP challenge column in every main activity; group-explainer role; Worked Example 1.7, irrational closure and the √2 proof.',
        absent: '**Absentees and latecomers:** a catch-up page (the Notes and Worked Examples 1.1 and 1.2); a study buddy shares the exit-ticket answers; the Lesson 2 review recaps Lesson 1.',
        behaviour: '**Learners who lose focus:** clear group roles and time limits; seat near the teacher; praise on-task behaviour; quick check-ins during group work.'
      };
      const sen = Object.keys(NEEDS).filter(k => ctx.need(k)).map(k => (ctx.count(k) && !/^\*\*[^*]*\(\d+\)/.test(SEN[k])) ? SEN[k].replace(':**', ` (${ctx.count(k)}):**`) : SEN[k]);
      out.push(B.p('**Learners with special educational needs, and inclusion (GESI)**', { before: 4, color: 'accent' }));
      out.push(B.ul(sen.length ? sen : ['No additional needs were selected. Keep the AP, P and HP tasks and watch for learners who need extra support.']));
      out.push(B.ul(['**Learners who finish early:** move to the next column (P to HP) instead of waiting.']));
      return out;
    },

    assessment: ctx => {
      const out = [];
      out.push(B.h('1. Formative assessment', { before: 0 }));
      const modes = { oral: 'oral questioning during each activity', boards: `show-me answers on ${ctx.boards}`, exit: 'exit tickets at the end of each lesson', observe: 'an observation checklist during group work (correct set names, reasons given, counterexamples found)', peer: 'peer assessment of the ordering tasks using the answers in the ' + lm, self: 'self-assessment with the Week 1 checklist', quiz: 'the ten-question Week 1 quiz' };
      const chosen = Object.keys(FORMATIVE).filter(k => ctx.fm(k)).map(k => modes[k]);
      out.push(B.p(`**Assessment mode:** ${chosen.length ? chosen.join('; ') : 'oral questioning'} (DoK Levels 1–2).`));
      out.push(B.p('**Task:**'));
      out.push(B.ol([
        r`**Lesson 1 exit ticket (Exercise 2):** place each number in its smallest set: $-\sqrt{49}$, $\sqrt{50}$, $0.\dot{0}\dot{9}$, $125\%$, $-8$, $0$.`,
        r`**Lesson 2 exit ticket (Quiz 5 and 9):** choose the list in ascending order; name the kind of number whose decimal never ends and never repeats.`
      ]));
      out.push(B.p('**Mark scheme:**'));
      out.push(B.ul([
        r`Lesson 1 (6 marks, 1 each): $-7\in\mathbb{Z}$; $5\sqrt{2}$ irrational; $\dfrac{1}{11}\in\mathbb{Q}$; $\dfrac{5}{4}\in\mathbb{Q}$; $-8\in\mathbb{Z}$; $0\in W$.`,
        r`Lesson 2 (2 marks): $-\dfrac{3}{2},\ -1.3,\ 0,\ \sqrt{2}$ (1); irrational number (1).`,
        'Use the scores to regroup learners (AP, P, HP) for the next lesson.'
      ]));
      if (ctx.fm('quiz')) out.push(B.p(r`**Quiz (10 marks):** answers: 1 integers; 2 $\sqrt{15}$; 3 $\dfrac{5}{11}$; 4 closed under subtraction; 5 $-\dfrac{3}{2},-1.3,0,\sqrt{2}$; 6 $\dfrac{7}{90}$; 7 $0$; 8 $\sqrt{5}\times\sqrt{5}=5$; 9 irrational; 10 $2$.`, { size: 9 }));

      // key assessment: the Teacher Manual's Week 1 items, chosen to fit the time, with full mark schemes
      const Q = [
        { id: 'g', lvl: 3, dok: 3, t: 10, m: 8, q: r`Convert the recurring decimals to fractions in their simplest form: $0.\dot{5}$, $0.\dot{6}\dot{2}$, $1.\dot{6}$ and $2.\dot{8}\dot{1}$.`, a: r`2 marks each (method, answer): $10x-x=5$, $x=\dfrac{5}{9}$; $100x-x=62$, $x=\dfrac{62}{99}$; $10x-x=15$, $x=\dfrac{15}{9}=\dfrac{5}{3}$; $100x-x=279$, $x=\dfrac{279}{99}=\dfrac{31}{11}$.` },
        { id: 'b', lvl: 2, dok: 3, t: 10, m: 6, q: r`Investigate whether each subset $\mathbb{N}$, $W$, $\mathbb{Z}$, $\mathbb{Q}$ and $\mathbb{R}$ is closed under $+$, $-$, $\times$ and $\div$. Give an example or a counterexample for each answer.`, a: r`$\mathbb{N}$ and $W$: closed under $+$ and $\times$ only, e.g. $2-5=-3\notin\mathbb{N}$, $1\div2=\dfrac{1}{2}\notin W$ (2); $\mathbb{Z}$: closed under $+$, $-$, $\times$, not $\div$, e.g. $7\div3$ (2); $\mathbb{Q}$ and $\mathbb{R}$: closed under all four, with division by non-zero numbers only (2).` },
        { id: 'f', lvl: 3, dok: 3, t: 8, m: 6, q: r`Classify each number as rational or irrational, with a reason: $75\%$, $0.714285714285\ldots$, $\dfrac{125}{11050}$, $\sqrt{8}$, $\pi$, $\dfrac{2\sqrt{7}}{3}$.`, a: r`1 mark each: $75\%=\dfrac{3}{4}$ rational; $0.714285\ldots=\dfrac{5}{7}$ rational (the block $714285$ recurs); $\dfrac{125}{11050}=\dfrac{5}{442}$ rational; $\sqrt{8}=2\sqrt{2}$ irrational; $\pi$ irrational; $\dfrac{2\sqrt{7}}{3}$ irrational ($7$ is not a perfect square).` },
        { id: 'a', lvl: 2, dok: 2, t: 8, m: 5, q: r`Use a Venn diagram, a flow chart or a number line to show the subsets of the real number system, with one example in each subset.`, a: r`Nesting $\mathbb{N}\subset W\subset\mathbb{Z}\subset\mathbb{Q}\subset\mathbb{R}$ shown (2); irrational numbers inside $\mathbb{R}$ but outside $\mathbb{Q}$ (1); a correct example in each region, e.g. $7$, $0$, $-3$, $\dfrac{5}{8}$, $\sqrt{2}$ (2; 1 mark for three correct).` },
        { id: 'e', lvl: 3, dok: 2, t: 6, m: 4, q: r`Give at least two real-life applications each of rational and irrational numbers.`, a: r`1 mark each, e.g. rational: prices and change (GH₵ $2.50$), a dosage of $2.5$ ml; irrational: the diagonal of a square tile ($\sqrt{2}$ m), the circumference $2\pi r$ of a round tank.` },
        { id: 'c', lvl: 2, dok: 3, t: 8, m: 5, q: r`Investigate real-life applications of the subsets of $\mathbb{R}$ in transactions, computing, medicine, agriculture and energy.`, a: r`1 mark for each area with a correct number and set, e.g. a debt of GH₵ $40$ ($-40\in\mathbb{Z}$); binary digits $0$ and $1$ ($W$); a dose of $2.5$ ml ($\mathbb{Q}$); a plot diagonal $10\sqrt{2}$ m (irrational); a circular turbine path $2\pi r$ (irrational).` },
        { id: 'd', lvl: 2, dok: 4, t: 12, m: 6, q: r`**Hunter’s bag:** a hunter’s bag holds a python that swallowed a hawk that swallowed a chick that swallowed a grain of corn. Draw a Venn diagram of this and use it to explain how $\mathbb{N}$, $W$, $\mathbb{Z}$, $\mathbb{Q}$ and $\mathbb{R}$ fit together.`, a: r`Correct nested Venn diagram: bag ⊃ python ⊃ hawk ⊃ chick ⊃ corn (3); matching corn–$\mathbb{N}$, chick–$W$, hawk–$\mathbb{Z}$, python–$\mathbb{Q}$, bag–$\mathbb{R}$ (2); explanation that each set lies inside the next (1).` }
      ];
      const mins = +ctx.s.keyMins || 40;
      let used = 0; const pick = [];
      for (const q of Q) { if (q.id === 'd' && mins < 60) continue; if (used + q.t <= mins || pick.length < 2) { pick.push(q); used += q.t; } }
      const L2 = pick.filter(q => q.lvl === 2), L3 = pick.filter(q => q.lvl === 3);
      const total = pick.reduce((t, q) => t + q.m, 0);
      const modeName = { class: 'Individual written class exercise', quiz: 'Class test (quiz conditions)', homework: 'Take-home assignment, marked in class', test: 'End-of-week test' }[ctx.s.keyMode] || 'Individual written class exercise';
      out.push(B.h('2. Key assessment for the Student Transcript Portal', { before: 6 }));
      out.push(B.p(`**Assessment mode:** ${modeName}, ${mins} minutes, at the end of Lesson 2 or the start of Week 2. Items are the Teacher Manual’s Week 1 key assessment (DoK Levels ${[...new Set(pick.map(q => q.dok))].sort().join(', ')}).`));
      out.push(B.p('**Task:**'));
      let n = 0;
      if (L2.length) { out.push(B.p('**Section A** (Teacher Manual, Level 2): answer every question.', { size: 9.5 })); out.push(B.ol(L2.map(q => `${q.q} **[${q.m} marks; DoK ${q.dok}]**`))); }
      if (L3.length) { out.push(B.p('**Section B** (Teacher Manual, Level 3): answer every question.', { size: 9.5 })); out.push(B.ol(L3.map(q => `${q.q} **[${q.m} marks; DoK ${q.dok}]**`))); }
      out.push(B.p(`**Rubric / mark scheme (${total} marks):**`, { before: 3, keep: true }));
      out.push(B.ul([...L2.map((q, i) => `**A${i + 1}:** ${q.a}`), ...L3.map((q, i) => `**B${i + 1}:** ${q.a}`)], { size: 9 }));
      const lv = p => Math.round(total * p);
      out.push(B.p(`**Performance levels:** ${lv(0.8)}–${total} highly proficient; ${lv(0.6)}–${lv(0.8) - 1} proficient; ${lv(0.4)}–${lv(0.6) - 1} approaching proficiency; below ${lv(0.4)}: plan support in Week 2. Record the scores on the Student Transcript Portal.`, { size: 9 }));
      const left = Q.filter(q => !pick.includes(q));
      if (left.length) out.push(B.note(`Not set for time: ${left.map(q => q.id === 'd' ? 'the hunter’s bag (DoK 4) — give it to HP learners as a challenge' : 'the ' + (q.id === 'c' ? 'five-area applications investigation' : q.id === 'e' ? 'real-life applications question' : 'remaining item')).join('; ')}.`, { size: 9 }));
      return out;
    },

    reflection: ctx => [
      B.p('To be completed by the teacher after each lesson.', { size: 9, italic: true }),
      B.ul([
        r`Lesson 1: Which numbers caused confusion in the card sort (e.g. $0$, $\sqrt{81}$, $0.\dot{2}\dot{7}$)? Could learners convert $0.3636\ldots$ to a fraction without help? ……………………………………………`,
        r`Lesson 2: Did learners find their own counterexamples for closure? Could they order $-\dfrac{7}{4}$ and $\sqrt{2}$ correctly? ……………………………………………`,
        'Number of learners after the key assessment: HP ……… P ……… AP ……… Needs support ………',
        'Follow-up for Week 2 (Properties of Operations and Sets) and for learners who were absent: ……………………………………………',
        'Remarks by head of department / critical friend: ……………………………………………'
      ], { size: 9 })
    ]
  };
})();

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Generic week builder (Years 1–3).
   Turns a compiled Learner Material pack (notes, worked examples, quiz, exercise,
   theory, summary, checklist and the two-lesson plan worked out at build time)
   plus the Teacher Manual data for the week into a planner week with the same
   shape as the hand-written Year 1 Week 1.  Every example, exercise and
   question comes from that week's Learner Material; header wording, indicators,
   pedagogical exemplars and key-assessment tasks come from the Teacher Manual.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
const GEN = (() => {
  const YW = { 1: 'One', 2: 'Two', 3: 'Three' };
  const LM = 'Learner Material';

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ text helpers */
  const STOP = new Set('the and for with that this from are was were has have had its into their them they then than when what which while where who how why can will may also each such been being both more most some only other over very use used using about after before between your our you not but all any one two three four five six first second same like just make makes made per of to in on at by an a is be or as it we'.split(' '));
  const plainT = s => String(s || '').replace(/\$[^$]*\$/g, ' ').replace(/\\[a-zA-Z]+/g, ' ').replace(/[*_{}()\[\],.;:!?“”"‘’'\/\\|<>=+−-]/g, ' ');
  const tokens = s => plainT(s).toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length >= 3 && !STOP.has(w)).map(w => w.replace(/(ies|es|s)$/, m => m === 'ies' ? 'y' : ''));
  function sim(a, b) {
    const A = new Map(); a.forEach(w => A.set(w, (A.get(w) || 0) + 1));
    let hit = 0; const seen = new Set();
    for (const w of b) if (A.has(w) && !seen.has(w)) { hit += 1; seen.add(w); }
    return hit / Math.sqrt((new Set(a).size || 1) * (new Set(b).size || 1));
  }
  const len = s => plainT(s).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().length + (String(s).match(/\$/g) || []).length * 3;
  // split prose into sentences without breaking $maths$ or abbreviations
  function sentences(t) {
    t = String(t || ''); const out = []; let cur = ''; let m = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < t.length; i++) {
      const c = t[i]; cur += c;
      if (c === '$') m = !m;
      if (m || !(c === '.' || c === '?' || c === '!')) continue;
      const nx = t[i + 1];
      if (nx !== undefined && nx !== ' ' && nx !== '*') continue;
      let j = i + 1; while (t[j] === '*') { cur += '*'; j++; }
      const rest = t.slice(j).trimStart();
      if (/(?:\be\.g|\bi\.e|\betc|\bvs|\bcf|\bNo|\bFig|\bEx)\.$/.test(cur)) { i = j - 1; continue; }
      if (!rest || /^[A-Z0-9“"(\[$*\\]/.test(rest)) { out.push(cur.trim()); cur = ''; }
      i = j - 1;
    }
    if (cur.trim()) out.push(cur.trim());
    return out;
  }
  const balance = s => { s = String(s); if (((s.match(/\*\*/g) || []).length) % 2) s += '**'; if (((s.replace(/\\\$/g, '').match(/\$/g) || []).length) % 2) s = s.replace(/\$[^$]*$/, '').trim(); return s; };
  const clip = (t, n, max = 600) => { const ss = sentences(t); let out = ''; for (const s of ss.slice(0, n)) { if (out && (out + ' ' + s).length > max) break; out = out ? out + ' ' + s : s; } return balance(out || ss[0] || t); };
  const lc1 = s => /^[A-Z][a-z]/.test(s) && !/^(I|I'm|JHS|SHS|GH|Ghana|Venn|Pythagoras|De Morgan|Euler|Cartesian|Accra|Kumasi)\b/.test(s) ? s[0].toLowerCase() + s.slice(1) : s;
  const endDot = s => /[.?!:]$/.test(s.trim()) ? s.trim() : s.trim() + '.';
  const noDot = s => s.trim().replace(/[.]+$/, '');
  const joinAnd = arr => arr.length <= 1 ? (arr[0] || '') : arr.slice(0, -1).join(', ') + ' and ' + arr[arr.length - 1];
  const numList = ns => {
    const a = [...new Set(ns)].sort((x, y) => x - y); const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < a.length;) { let j = i; while (j + 1 < a.length && a[j + 1] === a[j] + 1) j++; out.push(j - i >= 2 ? `${a[i]}–${a[j]}` : a.slice(i, j + 1).join(', ')); i = j + 1; }
    return out.join(', ');
  };
  const quote = t => `“${noDot(t)}”`;
  // a section title as a topic phrase: “What are simultaneous equations?” → “Simultaneous equations”
  const topic = t => {
    let x = noDot(t).replace(/^Review:\s*/i, 'Review of ').replace(/^Recall:\s*/i, 'Recall of ');
    const m = /^(?:What|Which)\s+(?:is|are)\s+(?:a|an|the)?\s*(.+?)\?$/i.exec(x);
    if (m) x = m[1][0].toUpperCase() + m[1].slice(1);
    else if (/^(How|Why|When)\b.*\?$/i.test(x)) x = x.replace(/\?$/, '');
    return x;
  };

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ blocks from the Learner Material */
  const BOXLAB = { definition: 'Definition', key: 'Key idea', formula: 'Key result', warn: 'Common error to correct', tip: 'Teaching tip', life: 'In daily life', note: 'Note' };
  function tableB(b, o = {}) {
    let head = b.head && b.head.length ? b.head : null;
    let rows = (b.rows || []).slice(0, o.maxRows || 12);
    // a long two-column table of short entries (a frequency table) reads better across the page
    if (head && head.length === 2 && rows.length >= 4 && rows.length <= 11 && rows.every(r => r.length === 2 && len(r[0]) <= 14 && len(r[1]) <= 14)) {
      const n = rows.length + 1, lab = Math.max(14, Math.min(26, Math.max(len(head[0]), len(head[1])) * 1.4));
      const each = (100 - lab) / rows.length;
      const cols = [Math.round(lab), ...rows.map(() => Math.floor(each))];
      cols[cols.length - 1] += 100 - cols.reduce((a, v) => a + v, 0);
      return B.table({ cols, fill: 'F2CEED', small: true, head: [head[0], ...rows.map(r => String(r[0]))], rows: [[head[1], ...rows.map(r => String(r[1]))]], across: n });
    }
    const ncol = Math.max(head ? head.length : 0, ...rows.map(r => r.length));
    if (!ncol) return null;
    const wts = Array.from({ length: ncol }, (_, i) => {
      const ls = [head ? head[i] : '', ...rows.map(r => r[i] || '')].map(x => Math.min(60, len(x)));
      return Math.max(6, ls.reduce((a, v) => a + v, 0) / ls.length + 0.3 * Math.max(...ls));
    });
    const tot = wts.reduce((a, v) => a + v, 0);
    let cols = wts.map(v => Math.max(8, Math.round(100 * v / tot)));
    const fix = 100 - cols.reduce((a, v) => a + v, 0); cols[cols.indexOf(Math.max(...cols))] += fix;
    const short = rows.every(r => r.every(c => len(c) <= 16));    const norm = r => Array.from({ length: ncol }, (_, i) => String(r[i] ?? ''));
    return B.table({ cols, fill: 'F2CEED', small: short, head: head ? norm(head) : undefined, rows: rows.map(norm) });
  }
  function boxB(b) {
    const lab = BOXLAB[b.kind] || 'Note';
    const out = []; let first = true;
    const pre = `**${lab}${b.title && !new RegExp('^' + lab + '$', 'i').test(b.title) ? ' – ' + noDot(b.title) : ''}:** `;
    for (const x of b.blocks || []) {
      if (x.k === 'p') { out.push(B.p((first ? pre : '') + x.text)); first = false; }
      else if (x.k === 'ul' || x.k === 'ol') { if (first) { out.push(B.p(pre.trim())); first = false; } out.push(B[x.k](x.items.slice(0, 8))); }
      else if (x.k === 'math') { if (first) { out.push(B.p(pre.trim())); first = false; } out.push(B.math(x.tex)); }
      else if (x.k === 'table') { if (first) { out.push(B.p(pre.trim())); first = false; } const t = tableB(x); if (t) out.push(t); }
    }
    if (first) out.push(B.p(pre.trim()));
    return out;
  }
  // choose the parts of a Notes section that a teacher needs to present, within a character budget
  function exposition(sec, budget) {
    const units = [];
    let firstP = true;
    (sec.blocks || []).forEach((b, i) => {
      if (b.k === 'fig') return;
      if (b.k === 'p') {
        if (firstP) { units.push({ i, pri: 1, cost: len(clip(b.text, 2)), make: () => [B.p(clip(b.text, 2, 520))] }); firstP = false; }
        else units.push({ i, pri: 3, cost: len(clip(b.text, 1)), make: () => [B.p(clip(b.text, 1, 360))] });
      } else if (b.k === 'box') {
        const pri = { definition: 1, key: 1, formula: 1, warn: 2, tip: 3, life: 3, note: 4 }[b.kind] || 3;
        const cost = (b.blocks || []).reduce((t, x) => t + (x.k === 'p' ? len(x.text) : x.k === 'math' ? 40 : x.k === 'table' ? 25 * (x.rows || []).length * (x.head || [1]).length : (x.items || []).reduce((u, it) => u + len(it), 0)), 30);
        units.push({ i, pri, cost, make: () => boxB(b), kind: b.kind });
      } else if (b.k === 'math') units.push({ i, pri: 2, cost: 45, make: () => [B.math(b.tex)] });
      else if (b.k === 'ul' || b.k === 'ol') units.push({ i, pri: 2, cost: b.items.slice(0, 7).reduce((t, it) => t + len(it), 0), make: () => [B[b.k](b.items.slice(0, 7))] });
      else if (b.k === 'table') {
        const r = (b.rows || []).length, c = Math.max((b.head || []).length, ...(b.rows || []).map(x => x.length));
        units.push({ i, pri: r <= 9 && c <= 6 ? 2 : 5, cost: 18 * (r + 1) * c, make: () => { const t = tableB(b); return t ? [t] : []; } });
      } else if (b.k === 'h3') units.push({ i, pri: 3, cost: 20, make: () => [B.p(`**${b.text}**`)] });
    });
    const order = units.slice().sort((a, b) => a.pri - b.pri || a.i - b.i);
    const take = new Set(); let used = 0, warns = 0;
    for (const u of order) {
      if (u.pri >= 5) continue;
      if (u.kind === 'warn' && warns >= 1) continue;
      if (used + u.cost > budget && take.size) continue;
      take.add(u); used += u.cost; if (u.kind === 'warn') warns++;
    }
    return units.filter(u => take.has(u)).flatMap(u => u.make());
  }
  function problemOf(ex) {
    const ps = [], extra = [];
    for (const b of ex.problem || []) {
      if (b.k === 'p') ps.push(b.text);
      else if (b.k === 'math') extra.push(B.math(b.tex));
      else if (b.k === 'table') { const t = tableB(b, { maxRows: 10 }); if (t) extra.push(t); }
      else if (b.k === 'ul' || b.k === 'ol') extra.push(B[b.k](b.items));
    }
    return { text: ps.join(' '), extra };
  }
  const stepStr = s => typeof s === 'string' ? s : '';
  const stepExtra = s => (s && typeof s === 'object' && s.table) ? tableB(s.table, { maxRows: 10 }) : (s && s.k === 'math') ? B.math(s.tex) : null;
  function compact(ex, max = 430) {
    const st = (ex.steps || []).map(stepStr).filter(Boolean).map(s => endDot(s));
    let t = st.join(' ');
    if (len(t) > max && st.length > 2) t = `${st[0]} … ${st[st.length - 1]}`;
    if (len(t) > max * 1.4) t = clip(t, 2, 520);
    return balance(t);
  }
  const answerOf = ex => { const a = String(ex.answer || '').trim(); if (!a) return ''; const last = stepStr((ex.steps || []).slice(-1)[0]); return last.includes(a) ? '' : a; };

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ the builder */
  function build(P) {
    const tm = P.tm || {};
    const Y = P.year, Wk = P.week, YName = YW[Y];
    const exLabel = i => `Example ${Wk}.${i + 1}`;
    const notes = P.notes, plan = P.plan;
    const figKey = id => `y${Y}:${id}`;
    const secTok = notes.map(n => tokens(n.title + ' ' + n.title + ' ' + (n.blocks || []).map(b => b.text || (b.items || []).join(' ') || (b.blocks || []).map(x => x.text || '').join(' ')).join(' ')));
    const hasStep = t => t && ((t.steps && t.steps.length) || (t.model && t.model.length));

    /* ---------- indicators (Teacher Manual, or the Learner Material outcomes when the manual is not available) */
    let indicators = (tm.indicators || []).filter(Boolean);
    const indFromLM = !indicators.length;
    if (indFromLM) indicators = P.outcomes.slice(0, Math.min(3, P.outcomes.length)).map(endDot);
    indicators = indicators.slice(0, 4);
    const indTok = indicators.map(tokens);

    /* ---------- activities from the two-lesson plan */
    const used = { quiz: new Set(), exer: new Set(), th: new Set() };
    // a section with four or more worked examples becomes two activities, so no activity runs too long
    plan.lessons = plan.lessons.map(L => L.flatMap(e => {
      if (e.exs.length < 3 || e.split) return [e];
      const h = Math.ceil(e.exs.length / 2);
      return [{ ...e, exs: e.exs.slice(0, h), split: true }, { ...e, notes: false, exs: e.exs.slice(h), split: true, part2: true }];
    }));
    const lessonSecs = plan.lessons.map(L => [...new Set(L.map(e => e.j))]);
    const inLesson = (arr, i) => arr.map((s, k) => ({ s, k })).filter(x => lessonSecs[i].includes(x.s)).map(x => x.k);
    const take = (kind, ks, n, pred = () => true) => { const out = []; for (const k of ks) { if (out.length >= n) break; if (!used[kind].has(k) && pred(k)) { used[kind].add(k); out.push(k); } } return out; };
    const quizLen = k => len(P.quiz[k].q) + P.quiz[k].options.reduce((t, o) => t + len(o), 0);
    const exerLen = k => len(P.exercise[k].q) + len(P.exercise[k].a);

    // 1. exit tickets: two short exercise items from what each lesson taught (latest sections first)
    const exits = [0, 1].map(i => {
      const ks = inLesson(plan.exerSec, i).sort((a, b) => lessonSecs[i].indexOf(plan.exerSec[b]) - lessonSecs[i].indexOf(plan.exerSec[a]) || a - b);
      let got = take('exer', ks.filter(k => exerLen(k) < 260), 2);
      if (got.length < 2) got = got.concat(take('exer', ks, 2 - got.length));
      if (!got.length) got = take('exer', P.exercise.map((_, k) => k), 1);
      return got.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    });
    // 2. key-assessment theory items (with worked answers), longest first; homework items
    const thAll = P.theory.map((_, k) => k);
    const kaN = Y === 1 || !(tm.assess || []).some(a => a.items.some(it => it.clean)) ? 3 : 2;
    const kaTh = take('th', thAll.filter(k => hasStep(P.theory[k])).sort((a, b) => len(P.theory[b].q) - len(P.theory[a].q)).slice(0, kaN).sort((a, b) => a - b), kaN);
    // 3. starters: one quiz question per lesson from its first new section
    const starterQ = [0, 1].map(i => {
      const first = plan.lessons[i].find(e => e.notes) || plan.lessons[i][0];
      const ks = inLesson(plan.quizSec, i).sort((a, b) => (plan.quizSec[a] === (first && first.j) ? -1 : 0) - (plan.quizSec[b] === (first && first.j) ? -1 : 0) || quizLen(a) - quizLen(b));
      return take('quiz', ks, 1)[0];
    });

    let actNo = 0; let figNo = 0;
    const figsPlan = (plan.figs || []).map((f, k) => ({ ...f, n: k + 1 }));
    const exUsed = new Set();
    const acts = plan.lessons.map((L, i) => L.map((e, k) => {
      const sec = notes[e.j] || { title: 'Notes', blocks: [] };
      const continued = !e.notes;
      const a = { i, k, j: e.j, sec, continued, part2: !!e.part2, exs: e.exs.slice(), id: (i === 0 ? 'a' : 'b') + (k + 1) };
      a.title = e.part2 ? `${noDot(topic(sec.title))}: further examples` : continued ? `${noDot(sec.title)} (continued)` : noDot(sec.title);
      a.figs = figsPlan.filter(f => f.lesson === i + 1 && f.sec === e.j && (f.ex === undefined || f.ex === null ? !continued || !L.some(x => x.j === e.j && x.notes) : e.exs.includes(f.ex)));
      e.exs.forEach(x => exUsed.add(x));
      // weight → time
      const nw = continued ? 0 : (sec.blocks || []).reduce((t, b) => t + (b.k === 'p' ? 0.5 * len(b.text) : b.k === 'box' ? 140 : b.k === 'table' ? 180 : b.k === 'fig' ? 90 : b.k === 'math' ? 50 : 60), 0);
      a.w = 180 + Math.min(1500, nw) + 620 * e.exs.length;
      // tiers
      const ap = take('quiz', plan.quizSec.map((s, q) => s === e.j ? q : -1).filter(q => q >= 0), 2);
      const pp = take('exer', plan.exerSec.map((s, q) => s === e.j ? q : -1).filter(q => q >= 0), 2);
      const hp = take('th', plan.thSec.map((s, q) => s === e.j ? q : -1).filter(q => q >= 0), 1);
      a.tier = { ap, p: pp, hp };
      // indicator
      const tk = tokens(sec.title + ' ' + sec.title + ' ' + e.exs.map(x => P.examples[x].title).join(' ')).concat(secTok[e.j] || []);
      let best = 0, bv = -1; indTok.forEach((t, q) => { const v = sim(t, tk); if (v > bv) { bv = v; best = q; } });
      a.ind = [best + 1];
      a.tok = tk;
      return a;
    }));
    // every indicator taught somewhere: give an untaught indicator to its best-matching activity
    const flat = acts.flat();
    indicators.forEach((_, q) => {
      if (flat.some(a => a.ind.includes(q + 1))) return;
      let b = null, bv = -1; for (const a of flat) { const v = sim(indTok[q], a.tok); if (v > bv) { bv = v; b = a; } }
      if (b) b.ind.push(q + 1);
    });
    // fill empty tiers from what is left in the same lesson, then from the whole week
    for (const a of flat) {
      if (!a.tier.ap.length) a.tier.ap = take('quiz', inLesson(plan.quizSec, a.i), 1);
      if (!a.tier.p.length) a.tier.p = take('exer', inLesson(plan.exerSec, a.i), 1);
      if (!a.tier.hp.length) a.tier.hp = take('th', inLesson(plan.thSec, a.i), 1);
    }
    for (const a of flat) {
      if (!a.tier.p.length) a.tier.p = take('exer', P.exercise.map((_, k) => k), 1);
      if (!a.tier.ap.length) a.tier.ap = take('quiz', P.quiz.map((_, k) => k), 1);
    }
    // HP tasks still empty: the most demanding Exercise question left in the lesson
    for (const a of flat) if (!a.tier.hp.length) {
      const ks = inLesson(plan.exerSec, a.i).filter(k => !used.exer.has(k)).sort((x, y) => len(P.exercise[y].q) - len(P.exercise[x].q));
      if (ks.length && len(P.exercise[ks[0]].q) > 40) { used.exer.add(ks[0]); a.tier.hpEx = [ks[0]]; }
    }
    // homework: a Theory question per lesson if any is left
    const hw = [0, 1].map(i => take('th', inLesson(plan.thSec, i).concat(thAll), 1));
    // recap questions (team quiz) from what is left
    const recapQ = [0, 1].map(i => take('quiz', inLesson(plan.quizSec, i), 3));
    // pedagogical exemplars of the Teacher Manual matched to activities
    const PED = /\b(learners?|groups?|pairs?|engage|whole[- ]class|class discussion|collaborative|think[- ]pair|talk for learning|experiential|problem[- ]based|task|investigat|discuss)\w*/i;
    tm.exemplars = (tm.exemplars || []).filter(t => PED.test(t) && !/\bo [A-Z][a-z]/.test(t) && !/\?\s*o\b/.test(t));
    const exm = tm.exemplars.map(t => ({ t, tok: tokens(t), used: false }));
    for (const a of flat) {
      let b = null, bv = 0.08;
      for (const x of exm) { if (x.used) continue; const v = sim(x.tok, a.tok); if (v > bv) { bv = v; b = x; } }
      if (b) { b.used = true; a.exemplar = b.t; }
    }
    // the lightest activity of a crowded lesson may drop to homework reading
    acts.forEach(L => {
      L.forEach(a => { a.pri = 1; });
      if (L.length >= 5) { const c = L.filter(a => !a.exs.length).sort((x, y) => x.w - y.w)[0]; if (c) c.pri = 2; }
    });
    // minutes for an 80-minute lesson (60 minutes of main lesson), and the least an activity can take
    acts.forEach(L => {
      const tot = L.reduce((t, a) => t + a.w, 0) || 1;
      L.forEach(a => { a.base = Math.max(6, Math.round(60 * a.w / tot)); a.min = Math.max(5, Math.round(a.base * (a.exs.length ? 0.6 : 0.5))); });
    });
    // extensions (only used when the lesson is long, or many learners are HP)
    const extTh = [0, 1].map(i => take('th', inLesson(plan.thSec, i).concat(thAll), 1)[0]);

    /* ---------- formatting helpers that need the class context */
    const quizTxt = (k, withOpts) => {
      const q = P.quiz[k]; if (!q) return '';
      const ans = q.options[q.correct];
      const opts = withOpts ? ' ' + q.options.map((o, i) => `(${'ABCD'[i]}) ${o}`).join('  ') : '';
      const stem = /[?.:!)]$/.test(q.q.trim()) || /\$$/.test(q.q.trim()) && /[=]\s*\$$/.test(q.q.trim()) ? q.q.trim() : q.q.trim() + ' …';
      return `**Quiz ${k + 1}:** ${stem}${opts} **Answer:** ${ans}${!withOpts && q.explain && len(q.explain) < 140 ? ` (${noDot(q.explain)})` : ''}.`.replace(/\.\.$/, '.');
    };
    const quizBits = k => { const q = P.quiz[k]; const stem = q.q.trim(); return { stem: /[?.:!)]$/.test(stem) ? stem : stem + ' …', opts: q.options.map((o, i) => `(${'ABCD'[i]}) ${o}`).join('   '), ans: q.options[q.correct], why: q.explain && len(q.explain) < 160 ? noDot(q.explain) : '' }; };
    const exerTxt = (k, ans = true) => { const q = P.exercise[k]; if (!q) return ''; return `**Exercise ${k + 1}:** ${q.q}${ans && q.a ? ` **Answer:** ${q.a}` : ''}`; };
    const thTxt = k => { const q = P.theory[k]; if (!q) return ''; return `**Theory ${k + 1}:** ${q.q}`; };
    const warnOf = sec => { for (const b of sec.blocks || []) if (b.k === 'box' && b.kind === 'warn') { const t = (b.blocks || []).find(x => x.k === 'p'); if (t) return clip(t.text, 1, 260); } return ''; };
    const keyw = (P.keywords || []).slice(0, 8);
    const lang = ctx => ctx.lang ? ` (they may first explain in ${ctx.lang}, then in English)` : ' (they may first explain in a familiar Ghanaian language, then in English)';
    const famRes = {
      number: 'number cards', algebra: 'algebra cards', geometry: 'shape and diagram cards', data: 'data cards'
    }[P.family] || 'task cards';
    const cardsFor = ctx => ctx.has('printer') ? `printed ${famRes}` : ctx.has('manila') ? `${famRes} cut from manila card` : `${famRes} cut from used exercise-book covers`;

    function figBlocks(a, c) {
      if (!c.figs || !a.figs.length) return [];
      return a.figs.flatMap(f => {
        const cap = f.caption || (f.ex != null ? `${exLabel(f.ex)}: ${noDot(P.examples[f.ex].title)}.` : noDot(a.sec.title) + '.');
        const img = (typeof FIGS !== 'undefined' && FIGS[figKey(f.id)]) || { w: 400, h: 250 };
        const ratio = img.w / img.h;
        const cm = ratio >= 1.9 ? 10.5 : ratio >= 1.35 ? 8.5 : ratio >= 0.95 ? 6.8 : 5.6;
        return [B.p(`${c.Show(`Figure ${f.n}`)} and talk the class through it.`), B.fig(figKey(f.id), `Figure ${f.n}. ${cap}`, cm)];
      });
    }
    function exampleBlocks(x, mode, c) {
      const ex = P.examples[x]; const pr = problemOf(ex); const lab = exLabel(x);
      const ans = answerOf(ex);
      const extras = (ex.steps || []).map(stepExtra).filter(Boolean);
      const steps = (ex.steps || []).map(stepStr).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 8);
      const who = mode === 'model' ? 'Teacher models' : mode === 'wedo' ? '“We do” together' : c.st('talk') ? 'Think–pair–share' : 'Pairs work';
      const out = [B.label(`${who}: ${lab} – ${noDot(ex.title)}`), B.p(`**Problem:** ${pr.text}`, { plain: true, keep: !pr.extra.length, size: mode === 'model' ? 10 : 9.7 }), ...pr.extra];
      if (mode !== 'model' && steps.length) out.push(B.p('**Solution (for checking):**', { plain: true, size: 9.4, before: 1 }));
      if (steps.length) out.push(B.ol(steps, mode === 'model' ? {} : { size: 9.4 }));
      out.push(...extras);
      if (ans) out.push(B.p(`**Answer:** ${ans}`, { plain: true, size: mode === 'model' ? 10 : 9.5 }));
      return out;
    }

    function activity(a) {
      const first = a.k === 0;
      const nEx = a.exs.length;
      const lead = a.part2 ? `Pairs and groups now practise ${quote(topic(a.sec.title))} with the remaining worked examples; the teacher models the first one briefly.` : a.continued ? `Continue “${noDot(a.sec.title)}” from Lesson ${a.i}.` : null;
      const body = c => {
        const out = [];
        const budget = { brief: 520, standard: 1000, detailed: 1600 }[c.detail] || 1000;
        // 1. what the teacher presents, point by point
        out.push(B.label(a.continued ? 'Continue' : 'Teach'));
        if (!a.continued) {
          const ph = [`Present the Notes ${quote(a.sec.title)}; write the key words and symbols on the board.`, `Teach ${quote(a.sec.title)} from the Notes.`, `Introduce ${quote(a.sec.title)} (Notes); ask learners to predict before you explain.`][(a.i + a.k) % 3];
          out.push(B.p(ph));
          out.push(...exposition(a.sec, nEx ? budget : budget * 1.3));
        } else out.push(B.p(lead));
        out.push(...figBlocks(a, c));
        if (a.exemplar && c.detail !== 'brief') out.push(B.p(`**Teacher Manual suggestion:** ${endDot(a.exemplar)}`, { size: 9.5 }));
        // 2. the worked examples: the teacher models the first, learners do the rest
        a.exs.forEach((x, q) => {
          const mode = q === 0 ? 'model' : (q === 1 && c.apHeavy ? 'wedo' : 'pairs');
          out.push(...exampleBlocks(x, mode, c));
        });
        // 3. how the class is organised for this activity
        const org = [];
        if (c.apHeavy && nEx) org.push(`**Extra modelling (about ${c.band.ap} AP learners):** before pairs start, do the first step of ${exLabel(a.exs[Math.min(1, nEx - 1)])} together on the board (“I do, we do”), saying each step aloud.`);
        if (c.hpHeavy && nEx > 1) org.push(`**Many HP learners (about ${c.band.hp}):** one HP learner in each group is the “explainer” and must convince the group of each step.`);
        if (c.st('collab') && nEx >= 2 && a.k === Math.min(1, acts[a.i].length - 1)) org.push(`**Group roles:** leader, recorder, checker, timekeeper, reporter${c.single ? '' : ' (girls and boys share the reporter role)'}; each reporter explains one example in one sentence.`);
        if (!nEx && !a.continued && c.st('talk')) org.push(`**Think–pair–share:** each learner writes the key idea of ${quote(topic(a.sec.title))} in one sentence, compares with a partner, then pairs share with the class.`);
        if (org.length) out.push(B.label('Organisation'), B.ul(org, { size: 9.5 }));
        return out;
      };
      const tiers = c => {
        const apT = a.tier.ap.map(k => quizTxt(k, false));
        const pT = a.tier.p.map(k => exerTxt(k));
        const hpT = a.tier.hp.map(k => thTxt(k)).concat((a.tier.hpEx || []).map(k => exerTxt(k).replace(/^\*\*Exercise (\d+):\*\*/, '**Exercise $1 (challenge):**')));
        const exA = a.exs[0] != null ? exLabel(a.exs[0]) : null, exB = a.exs[1] != null ? exLabel(a.exs[1]) : exA;
        if (!apT.length) apT.push(exA ? `Follow ${exA} with a prompt card of the steps; explain each step to a partner.` : `Copy the key words (${keyw.slice(0, 4).join(', ')}) with one example of each from the Notes.`);
        if (exA) apT.push([
          `Teacher checks the first step of ${exB || exA} before the learner continues.`,
          `Work beside a P learner (peer buddy) who checks each step of ${exB || exA}.`,
          `Sit with the teacher for ${exB || exA}; then try the next question alone.`
        ][(a.i * 2 + a.k) % 3]);
        if (!pT.length) pT.push(exB ? `Work ${exB} without looking at the solution, then check against the ${LM}.` : `Write and solve one question like those in ${quote(a.sec.title)}.`);
        if (!hpT.length) {
          const w = warnOf(a.sec);
          const lastEx = a.exs.length ? exLabel(a.exs[a.exs.length - 1]) : null;
          const alt = [
            lastEx ? `Explain to the group why each step of ${lastEx} is needed; then change one given number and solve the new question.` : null,
            lastEx ? `Solve ${lastEx} a second way (or check it a second way) and say which way is quicker and why.` : null,
            `Write a question like those in ${quote(a.sec.title)} that has a surprising answer, solve it and swap with another HP learner.`,
            lastEx ? `Make up a harder question like ${lastEx}, solve it and explain each step to the group.` : null
          ].filter(Boolean);
          hpT.push(w && (a.k % 2 === 0) ? `Explain to the group why this is an error and how to avoid it: ${w}` : alt[(a.i * 3 + a.k) % alt.length]);
        }
        return { ap: apT.slice(0, 3), p: pT.slice(0, 2), hp: hpT.slice(0, 2) };
      };
      const ex0 = a.exs[0] != null ? exLabel(a.exs[0]) : null;
      const hasFig = a.figs.length > 0, hasTable = (a.sec.blocks || []).some(b => b.k === 'table');
      const inc = {
        visual: c => hasFig ? `Describe Figure ${a.figs[0].n} aloud and give a large-print copy${c.has('tactile') ? ' or a raised (string-and-glue) version' : ''}; read every symbol aloud.` : hasTable ? 'Read the table aloud row by row; give a large-print copy.' : 'Read every number and symbol aloud as you write it; use a bold, high-contrast board.',
        hearing: `Write the key words${keyw.length ? ` (${keyw.slice(0, 4).join(', ')})` : ''} and every step on the board; face the class when you speak.`,
        reading: ex0 ? `Give the steps of ${ex0} as a model to follow line by line; read word problems aloud.` : 'Key-word wall with each word, its symbol and one example; read the Notes aloud.',
        language: c => 'Sentence frame on the board: “First I …, then I …, so …”' + lang(c) + '.'
      };
      if (nEx) Object.assign(inc, {
        attention: 'Break the task into numbered steps on the board; the learner ticks each step and you check after each one.',
        shy: 'Each learner writes an answer on a board or jotter before the pair or group discussion.',
        gifted: 'Start in the HP column, then act as the group explainer.',
        physical: 'Bring the materials to the learner’s desk; a partner writes or moves cards on request.',
        behaviour: 'Give clear roles and a visible time limit; praise pairs that stay on task.'
      });
      const ask = [];
      const qk = (P.plan.quizSec || []).map((s, q) => s === a.j ? q : -1).filter(q => q >= 0 && !a.tier.ap.includes(q))[0];
      if (qk != null) ask.push(P.quiz[qk].q);
      const w = warnOf(a.sec); if (w) ask.push(`What goes wrong here, and why? ${w}`);
      if (!ask.length && ex0) ask.push(`Why does each step of ${ex0} follow from the one before?`);
      actNo++;
      const label = a.continued ? `Activity ${a.k + 1} – ${a.title}` : `Activity ${a.k + 1} – ${a.title}${a.exs.length ? ` (${a.exs.length === 1 ? exLabel(a.exs[0]) : `Examples ${Wk}.${a.exs[0] + 1}–${Wk}.${a.exs[a.exs.length - 1] + 1}`})` : ''}`;
      return {
        id: a.id, ind: a.ind, title: label, base: a.base, min: a.min, pri: a.pri,
        org: c => nEx >= 2 ? (a.k === 0 ? 'teacher models, then pairs' : c.groups) : nEx === 1 ? 'teacher models, then pairs' : 'whole class, then pairs',
        drop: a.pri === 2 ? `${a.title} becomes reading homework: the Notes ${quote(a.sec.title)}.` : null,
        body, tiers, inc, ask
      };
    }

    /* ---------- lessons */
    const lessonTitle = i => {
      const ts = []; for (const a of acts[i]) { const t = topic(a.sec.title); if (!ts.includes(t)) ts.push(t); }
      const sh = ts.slice(0, 3).map((t, q) => q ? lc1(t) : t);
      return sh.length <= 2 ? sh.join(' and ') : `${sh[0]}, ${sh[1]} and ${sh[2]}`;
    };
    const refLesson = (i, items) => {
      const secs = acts[i].filter(a => !a.continued).map(a => quote(a.sec.title));
      const exs = [...new Set(acts[i].flatMap(a => a.exs))].map(x => x + 1);
      const fa = (tm.focal || []).length ? ` (Focal Area${tm.focal.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}: ${tm.focal.slice(0, 3).map(noDot).join('; ')})` : '';
      const q = [...items.quiz].map(k => k + 1), e = [...items.exer].map(k => k + 1), t = [...items.th].map(k => k + 1);
      return `Teacher Manual: Year ${YName}, Section ${tm.sectionNo || P.section.no}${tm.sectionName ? ` (${tm.sectionName})` : ''}, Week ${Wk}${fa}. ${LM} Week ${Wk}: Notes ${joinAnd(secs) || quote(acts[i][0].sec.title) + ' (continued)'}${exs.length ? `; ${exs.length === 1 ? 'Example' : 'Examples'} ${numList(exs).replace(/(\d+)/g, `${Wk}.$1`)}` : ''}${q.length ? `; Quiz ${numList(q)}` : ''}${e.length ? `; Exercise ${numList(e)}` : ''}${t.length ? `; Theory ${numList(t)}` : ''}.`;
    };
    const lessonItems = i => {
      const it = { quiz: new Set(), exer: new Set(), th: new Set() };
      acts[i].forEach(a => { a.tier.ap.forEach(k => it.quiz.add(k)); a.tier.p.forEach(k => it.exer.add(k)); a.tier.hp.forEach(k => it.th.add(k)); });
      if (starterQ[i] != null) it.quiz.add(starterQ[i]);
      exits[i].forEach(k => it.exer.add(k)); hw[i].forEach(k => it.th.add(k)); recapQ[i].forEach(k => it.quiz.add(k));
      return it;
    };
    const checks = (i) => (P.checklist || []).filter((_, k) => lessonSecs[i].includes((plan.chkSec || [])[k])).slice(0, 3).map(t => t.replace(/^I can\s+/i, ''));
    const summaryItems = i => { const all = (P.summary || []).flatMap(s => s.items); return all.filter((_, k) => lessonSecs[i].includes((plan.sumSec || [])[k])).slice(0, 4); };
    const nextTitle = P.next ? `Week ${Wk + 1} (${P.next})` : 'the next section';

    const lessons = [0, 1].map(i => {
      const A = acts[i].map(activity);
      const firstNew = acts[i].find(a => !a.continued) || acts[i][0];
      const isReview = /^(review|recall|revision|recap)/i.test(firstNew.sec.title);
      const hook = (() => {
        const lifeBox = acts[i].map(a => (a.sec.blocks || []).find(b => b.k === 'box' && b.kind === 'life')).find(Boolean);
        const fp = (firstNew.sec.blocks || []).find(b => b.k === 'p');
        if (i === 0 && fp) return clip(fp.text, 2, 420);
        if (lifeBox) { const t = (lifeBox.blocks || []).find(x => x.k === 'p'); if (t) return clip(t.text, 2, 420); }
        return fp ? clip(fp.text, 1, 300) : '';
      })();
      const sq = starterQ[i];
      const intro = [];
      if (i === 1) intro.push({
        id: 'review', title: 'Review of homework and exit tickets', base: 4, min: 3, pri: 2, org: 'whole class',
        body: c => [
          hw[0].length && c.s.homework ? B.p(`**Homework check:** two learners present Theory ${hw[0][0] + 1} on the board; the class checks each step.`) : null,
          B.p(`**Exit tickets:** clear up the errors seen on the Lesson 1 exit tickets.`),
          warnOf(acts[0][0].sec) ? B.p(`**Common error to revisit:** ${warnOf(acts[0][0].sec)}`) : null
        ].filter(Boolean),
        drop: 'Return the exit tickets with written comments instead of the oral review.'
      });
      intro.push({
        id: i === 0 ? 'starter' : 'starter2', title: `Starter: ${isReview && i === 0 ? 'what do we remember?' : noDot(firstNew.sec.title)}`, base: 6, min: 4, pri: 1, org: 'whole class',
        body: c => {
          const q = sq != null ? quizBits(sq) : null;
          return [
            hook ? B.p(`**Read aloud** (opening of the ${LM}): ${hook}`) : null,
            q ? B.p(`**Ask** (answers on ${c.boards}): Quiz ${sq + 1}: ${q.stem}`) : B.p(`**Ask:** “What do you already know about ${lc1(noDot(firstNew.sec.title))}?” Collect two or three answers on the board.`),
            q ? B.ul([q.opts]) : null,
            q ? B.p(`**Answer:** ${q.ans}${q.why ? ` (${q.why})` : ''}.`) : null,
            B.p(i === 0 ? '**Then:** accept all answers without correcting yet; they are settled in Activity 1. Use the answers as a quick diagnostic.' : '**Then:** use the answers to decide which pairs need the AP support cards today.')
          ].filter(Boolean);
        },
        inc: { hearing: 'Write the question and the options on the board as you read them.', shy: 'Every learner answers on a board or jotter first, so no one is singled out.' }
      });
      const sc = checks(i);
      if (i === 0) intro.push({
        id: 'criteria', title: 'Success criteria', base: 4, min: 3, pri: 2, org: 'whole class',
        body: c => [B.p('Share the success criteria. By the end of the lesson I can:', { plain: true }), B.ul((sc.length ? sc.map(t => noDot(lc1(t))) : [lc1(noDot(indicators[0]))]).map(t => endDot(t[0].toUpperCase() + t.slice(1))))],
        drop: 'Share the success criteria orally at the start of Activity 1.'
      });
      const main = A.slice();
      if (extTh[i] != null) main.push({
        id: 'x' + (i + 1), title: `Extension – Theory ${extTh[i] + 1}`, base: 10, min: 10, pri: 3, extra: true, org: 'HP learners, or the whole class',
        body: c => { const t = P.theory[extTh[i]]; const out = [B.p(`**Problem:** ${t.q} (Theory ${extTh[i] + 1})`, { plain: true })]; const st = (t.steps || []).map(stepStr).filter(Boolean); if (st.length) out.push(B.p('**Model answer:**', { plain: true, size: 9.5 }), B.ol(st.slice(0, 6), { size: 9.4 })); return out; }
      });
      const sm = summaryItems(i);
      const closeFor = ctx => [{
        id: i === 0 ? 'recap' : 'check', title: (ctx.st('game') && recapQ[i].length) ? 'Recap: team quiz' : (i === 1 && ctx.fm('self') ? 'Summary and self-assessment checklist' : 'Recap'), base: 4, min: 3, pri: 2, org: 'whole class',
        drop: i === 0 ? 'Ask the recap questions orally while learners hand in the exit ticket.' : `Set the ${LM} checklist as homework.`,
        body: c => {
          const out = [];
          if ((c.st('game') || c.fm('quiz')) && recapQ[i].length) { out.push(B.p(c.st('game') ? '**Team quiz:** groups score a point for each correct board answer.' : '**Quick quiz:**', { plain: true })); out.push(B.ol(recapQ[i].map(k => quizTxt(k, false)), { size: 9.5 })); }
          if (i === 1 && c.fm('self')) { out.push(B.p(`Learners mark each statement of the ${LM} checklist green, amber or red:`, { plain: true })); out.push(B.ul((P.checklist || []).map(t => endDot(t)), { size: 9.5 })); }
          else if (sm.length) { out.push(B.p('Learners state the key facts:', { plain: true })); out.push(B.ul(sm, { size: 9.5 })); }
          if (!out.length) out.push(B.p(`Learners state in one sentence each what they learnt about ${joinAnd(acts[i].filter(a => !a.continued).map(a => lc1(noDot(a.sec.title))).slice(0, 3))}.`));
          return out;
        }
      }, {
        id: 'exit' + (i + 1), exit: true, title: 'Exit ticket', base: 6, min: 4, pri: 1, org: 'individual',
        body: c => {
          const ex = exits[i];
          const out = [];
          if (ex.length) {
            out.push(B.p('Learners answer on their own:', { plain: true }));
            out.push(B.ol(ex.map(k => exerTxt(k, false))));
            out.push(B.p('**Answers (teacher):**', { plain: true, size: 9.4, before: 1 }));
            out.push(B.ul(ex.map(k => `Exercise ${k + 1}: ${endDot(P.exercise[k].a)}`), { size: 9.2 }));
            out.push(B.p(`**Then:** sort the tickets into AP, P and HP piles to regroup for ${i === 0 ? 'Lesson 2' : 'next week'}.`, { size: 9.5 }));
          } else out.push(B.p(`Learners write one thing they can now do and one question they still have about ${lc1(noDot(firstNew.sec.title))}.`));
          if (c.s.homework) {
            const h = hw[i][0];
            const restEx = P.exercise.map((_, k) => k).filter(k => !used.exer.has(k));
            if (h != null) out.push(B.p(`**Homework:** ${thTxt(h).replace(/^\*\*Theory/, 'Theory').replace(/:\*\*/, ':')}${i === 1 ? ` Read ahead to ${nextTitle}.` : ''}`));
            else if (restEx.length) out.push(B.p(`**Homework:** Exercise ${numList(restEx.slice(0, 3).map(k => k + 1))} from the ${LM}.${i === 1 ? ` Read ahead to ${nextTitle}.` : ''}`));
            else out.push(B.p(`**Homework:** read the Notes again and complete the ${LM} checklist.${i === 1 ? ` Read ahead to ${nextTitle}.` : ''}`));
          } else if (i === 1) out.push(B.p(`Preview ${nextTitle}.`));
          return out;
        }
      }];
      const items = lessonItems(i);
      return { title: lessonTitle(i), ref: refLesson(i, items), phases: ctx => ({ intro, main, close: closeFor(ctx) }) };
    });

    /* ---------- header */
    const weekTok = tokens(P.title + ' ' + P.subtitle + ' ' + P.outcomes.join(' '));
    const bestOf = list => { if (!list || !list.length) return ''; let b = list[0], bv = -1; for (const x of list) { const v = sim(tokens(x), weekTok); if (v > bv) { bv = v; b = x; } } return b; };
    const strand = tm.strand || P.section.strand;
    const substrand = tm.sub || '';
    const standard = bestOf(tm.cs) || `Demonstrate understanding of ${lc1(noDot(P.title))} and use it to solve problems.`;
    const outcome = bestOf(tm.lo) || endDot(P.outcomes[0] || P.title);
    const eqs = () => P.outcomes.slice(0, 4).map(o => {
      const t = noDot(o);
      const first = (t.match(/^[A-Za-z]+/) || [''])[0];
      if (/^(The|A|An|This|These|Each|Every|All|Some|Learners?|Students?)$/.test(first)) return `Why is it true that ${lc1(t)}?`;
      return `How can we ${first ? first.toLowerCase() + t.slice(first.length) : t}?`;
    });

    /* ---------- strategies */
    const exTitle = k => P.examples[k] ? noDot(P.examples[k].title) : '';
    const life = notes.flatMap(n => (n.blocks || []).filter(b => b.k === 'box' && b.kind === 'life')).map(b => b.title || ((b.blocks || []).find(x => x.k === 'p') || {}).text || '').filter(Boolean)[0];
    const KEYS = {
      problem: /problem[- ]based|real[- ]life|real world|everyday/i, talk: /talk for learning|think[- ]pair|discussion|whole[- ]class|brainstorm/i,
      collab: /collaborative|group|mixed[- ](ability|gender)/i, experiential: /experiential|hands[- ]on|model|practical|explore|draw|construct|measure/i,
      inquiry: /investigat|inquiry|research|discover/i, game: /game|quiz|competition/i, reflect: /reflect|self[- ]assess|portfolio/i
    };
    function strategies(ctx) {
      const tmx = tm.exemplars || [];
      const pickTM = k => tmx.find(t => KEYS[k].test(t));
      const S = {
        problem: `**Problem-based learning:** real situations from the ${LM}${life ? ` (${noDot(clip(life, 1, 120))})` : P.examples.length ? ` (${exLabel(P.examples.length - 1)}: ${exTitle(P.examples.length - 1)})` : ''} decide which method is needed.`,
        talk: '**Talk for Learning (think–pair–share):** learners try each example alone, compare with a partner, then agree in the group before reporting.',
        collab: `**Group work / collaborative learning:** ${ctx.groups} for the worked examples and the practice tasks, with rotating roles.`,
        experiential: `**Experiential learning:** ${P.family === 'geometry' ? 'learners draw, measure and construct with real instruments and objects from the classroom' : P.family === 'data' ? 'learners collect, organise and display real data from the class and the school' : P.family === 'algebra' ? 'learners build and test rules with tables, cards and graphs before writing them in symbols' : 'learners work with real quantities (money, measurements, counts) before the rule is written down'}.`,
        inquiry: '**Inquiry:** learners test claims and look for patterns or counterexamples before the rule is stated.',
        game: '**Gamification:** team points in the recap quiz.',
        reflect: `**Reflective practice:** exit tickets in both lessons and the ${LM} checklist at the end of the week.`
      };
      const items = Object.keys(STRATEGIES).filter(k => ctx.st(k)).map(k => S[k]);
      const out = [B.ul(items.length ? items : [S.talk])];
      if (tmx.length) out.push(B.p(`**Teacher Manual pedagogical exemplars (Week ${Wk}):**`, { before: 3, size: 9.5 }), B.ul(tmx.slice(0, ctx.detail === 'brief' ? 2 : 4).map(endDot), { size: 9.5 }));
      out.push(B.p('**Values and skills:** critical thinking, communication and collaboration; honesty, tolerance and respect for others’ views in group work.', { before: 3 }));
      return out;
    }

    /* ---------- resources */
    const allText = JSON.stringify(notes) + JSON.stringify(P.examples);
    const has = re => re.test(allText);
    function resources(ctx) {
      const figN = figsPlan.length;
      const it = [
        `Teacher Manual (Year ${YName}, Section ${tm.sectionNo || P.section.no}, Week ${Wk}) and the ${LM} Week ${Wk} notes${ctx.has('material') ? ' (copies for learners)' : ' (teacher’s copy; key examples written on the board)'}`,
        figN ? (ctx.has('projector') ? `Projector and laptop showing ${figN === 1 ? 'Figure 1' : 'Figures 1 and 2'}` : ctx.has('manila') ? `${figN === 1 ? 'Figure 1' : 'Figures 1 and 2'} drawn on manila charts before the lesson` : `${figN === 1 ? 'Figure 1' : 'Figures 1 and 2'} drawn on the board before the lesson`) : null,
        `${ctx.G} sets of ${cardsFor(ctx)} for the group tasks`,
        'Prompt cards with the steps of the modelled examples (for AP learners)',
        has(/graph|plot|coordinate|axes|gradient|parabola|curve|ogive|histogram/i) ? 'Graph sheets (or squared exercise books), rulers and pencils' : null,
        has(/construct|compasses|protractor|bisect|bearing|\\angle|angle/i) ? (ctx.has('maths_set') ? 'Mathematical sets (ruler, compasses, protractor) for every pair' : 'Rulers, a protractor and string (for arcs) for every pair') : null,
        has(/volume|surface area|prism|cylinder|cone|pyramid|sphere|cuboid/i) ? 'Models of solids (boxes, tins, cones) and measuring tapes' : null,
        has(/\b(probability|dice|die|coins?|spinners?)\b/i) ? 'Coins, dice or bottle tops for the experiments' : null,
        has(/survey|questionnaire|data|frequency|mean|median/i) && P.family === 'data' ? 'Data from the class (ages, heights, travel times) and sample questionnaires' : null,
        has(/GH₵|\\cedi|interest|price|profit|discount|tax|bill/i) ? 'Real or sample price lists, receipts or utility bills' : null,
        has(/number line/i) ? (ctx.has('tape') ? 'Masking tape or chalk for a floor number line' : 'A large number line drawn along the board') : null,
        has(/\\sin|\\cos|\\tan|\\log|calculator|decimal|standard form/i) || ctx.has('calculators') ? (ctx.has('calculators') ? 'Calculators (to check answers, not to replace the method)' : 'Four-figure tables (no calculators available)') : null,
        ctx.has('slates') ? 'Mini whiteboards or slates and markers' : 'Jotters or scrap paper for “show-me” answers',
        ctx.has('sticky') ? 'Sticky notes for individual answers' : null,
        ctx.digital ? 'GeoGebra (or a spreadsheet) on phones or the projector' : null,
        ctx.need('visual') ? `Large-print copies of the examples${ctx.has('tactile') ? ' and tactile materials (string, glue) for raised diagrams' : ''}` : null
      ];
      return [B.ul(it)];
    }

    /* ---------- differentiation */
    const reviewSec = notes.find(n => /^(review|recall|revision|recap)/i.test(n.title));
    const prereq = reviewSec ? lc1(noDot(reviewSec.title.replace(/^(review|recall|revision|recap)\s*(of|:)?\s*/i, ''))) : (P.family === 'number' ? 'fractions, decimals and negative numbers' : P.family === 'algebra' ? 'substitution, brackets and simple equations' : P.family === 'geometry' ? 'angles, shapes and measurement from JHS' : 'tables, charts and averages from JHS');
    function differentiation(ctx, lessonsT) {
      const out = []; const b = ctx.band;
      out.push(B.p(`**Class profile.** ${ctx.n} learners${ctx.single ? ` (all ${ctx.single})` : ` (${ctx.boys} boys, ${ctx.girls} girls)`}, ${ctx.progName}. ` + (b.known
        ? `${b.source === 'score' ? `Readiness estimated from the last test average (${b.score}%)` : 'Expected readiness'}: about **${b.ap} approaching proficiency (AP)**, **${b.p} proficient (P)** and **${b.hp} highly proficient (HP)**. Confirm with the Lesson 1 starter and the exit tickets.`
        : 'Readiness is not yet known: use the Lesson 1 starter as a diagnostic, then form readiness groups from the Lesson 1 exit ticket.')));
      const gtxt = [`**Grouping.** Exploration tasks use ${ctx.groups}`];
      if (b.known && b.hp) gtxt.push(`, each with ${ctx.perGroup.hp} HP learner${ctx.perGroup.hp === '1' ? '' : 's'} as explainer${ctx.perGroup.hp === '1' ? '' : 's'}`);
      if (!ctx.single) gtxt.push(` and about ${ctx.perGroup.girls} girls and ${ctx.perGroup.boys} boys per group`);
      gtxt.push('. Practice tasks use readiness groups (AP, P, HP). Roles (leader, recorder, checker, timekeeper, reporter) rotate every lesson.');
      out.push(B.p(gtxt.join('')));
      if (ctx.G <= 14 && ctx.G > 1) {
        const gp = ctx.groupPlan;
        const head = ['Group', 'Learners', ...(ctx.single ? [] : ['Girls', 'Boys']), ...(b.known ? ['HP', 'P', 'AP'] : []), 'Seating and support'];
        const w = ctx.single ? (b.known ? [10, 11, 9, 9, 9, 52] : [12, 13, 75]) : (b.known ? [9, 10, 8, 8, 7, 7, 7, 44] : [11, 12, 10, 10, 57]);
        out.push(B.p('**Group plan** (mixed-ability groups for exploration; front groups sit nearest the board):', { size: 9.5, before: 2 }));
        out.push(B.table({
          cols: w, fill: 'F2CEED', small: true, head,
          rows: gp.map(r => [String(r.g), String(r.size), ...(ctx.single ? [] : [String(r.girls), String(r.boys)]), ...(b.known ? [String(r.hp), String(r.p), String(r.ap)] : []),
            [r.front ? 'Front' : '', r.notes.length ? r.notes.join('; ') : ''].filter(Boolean).join(': ') || '–'])
        }));
      }
      if (ctx.single) out.push(B.p('**Gender.** A single-sex class: still rotate roles so that every learner leads and reports once during the week, and use examples from both girls’ and boys’ daily lives.'));
      else if (ctx.paired) out.push(B.p(`**Gender balance.** ${ctx.paired.who === 'girls' ? 'Girls' : 'Boys'} are a minority (${ctx.paired.who === 'girls' ? ctx.girls : ctx.boys} of ${ctx.n}), so they sit at least two to a group in ${ctx.paired.mixed} of the ${ctx.paired.groups} groups: nobody is the only ${ctx.paired.who === 'girls' ? 'girl' : 'boy'} in a group. ${ctx.paired.who === 'girls' ? 'Girls' : 'Boys'} report first in alternate activities, and questions go to girls and boys equally.`));
      else if (ctx.girlShare < 0.4) out.push(B.p(`**Gender balance.** Girls are a minority (${Math.round(ctx.girlShare * 100)}%): no group has only one girl, girls report first in alternate activities, and questions go to girls and boys equally.`));
      else if (ctx.girlShare > 0.6) out.push(B.p(`**Gender balance.** Boys are a minority (${Math.round((1 - ctx.girlShare) * 100)}%): no group has only one boy, and questions and reporting are shared equally.`));
      else out.push(B.p('**Gender balance.** The class is balanced: girls and boys share the leader and reporter roles equally, and questions go to both in turn.'));
      if (ctx.large) out.push(B.p(`**Large class (${ctx.n}).** Number the groups and the roles; group leaders collect and return materials; use a clap or hand signal for attention; mark exit tickets by sampling one group per lesson and the rest by peer marking.`));
      if (!ctx.movable) out.push(B.p('**Fixed benches.** Pairs work with their bench partner; for group tasks two benches turn to face each other.'));
      const col = band => {
        const items = [];
        lessonsT.forEach((x, i) => { for (const it of x.timing.main.items) if (it.tiers) { const t = it.tiers(ctx)[band]; items.push(`**Lesson ${i + 1}, ${it.title.split(' – ')[0]}:** ${t[0]}`); } });
        return items;
      };
      out.push(B.table({
        cols: [33, 34, 33], fill: 'F2CEED',
        head: [`Approaching proficiency (AP)${b.known ? ` – about ${b.ap}` : ''}`, `Proficient (P)${b.known ? ` – about ${b.p}` : ''}`, `Highly proficient (HP)${b.known ? ` – about ${b.hp}` : ''}`],
        sub: [`Not yet secure with ${prereq}`, `Secure with ${prereq}`, 'Grasp ideas quickly and need challenge'],
        rows: [[
          [B.p(`**Support:** prompt cards with the steps of the modelled examples; the first question of each task done together; key-word wall (${keyw.slice(0, 5).join(', ')}); teacher sits with this group at the start of each practice; peer buddy.`, { size: 9 }), B.ul(col('ap'), { size: 9 })],
          [B.p(`**Core:** the worked examples in pairs, then the Exercise questions of the ${LM} with answers checked in pairs.`, { size: 9 }), B.ul(col('p'), { size: 9 })],
          [B.p(`**Challenge:** explain to others; the Theory questions of the ${LM}; make up and solve harder questions; extension tasks when time allows.`, { size: 9 }), B.ul(col('hp'), { size: 9 })]
        ]]
      }));
      const kw = keyw.slice(0, 7).join(', ');
      const SEN = {
        visual: `**Low vision / visual impairment${ctx.count('visual') ? ` (${ctx.count('visual')})` : ''}:** seat in the front groups; large-print copies (24 pt and above) and a bold, high-contrast board; read every number and symbol aloud; describe each diagram${ctx.has('tactile') ? '; raised (string-and-glue) versions of the figures' : ''}.`,
        hearing: `**Hearing impairment${ctx.count('hearing') ? ` (${ctx.count('hearing')})` : ''}:** seat in the front groups facing the teacher; write instructions, key words and answers on the board; face the class when speaking; use gestures and agreed signals; check understanding through written answers; assign a note-taking buddy.`,
        physical: '**Physical / motor disability:** keep the aisles clear; bring the group task to the learner’s desk; a partner moves cards or writes on request; allow extra time for drawing tasks.',
        reading: '**Reading difficulty:** key-word wall with symbol and example; read word problems aloud; keep cards short; allow oral answers; extra time on the exit ticket.',
        attention: '**Attention difficulty:** short tasks with visible time limits; active roles (materials, timekeeper); seat away from the door and windows; a step checklist to tick.',
        language: `**Limited English:** pre-teach the key words${kw ? ` (${kw})` : ''} with symbols and examples; sentence frames; bilingual buddy${ctx.lang ? `; explanations may start in ${ctx.lang}` : '; explanations may start in a familiar Ghanaian language'}.`,
        shy: '**Shy or quiet learners:** think–pair–share before whole-class answers; answers on boards or sticky notes; give them the recorder role before the reporter role; praise effort and reasoning.',
        gifted: `**Gifted and talented:** HP challenge column in every main activity; group-explainer role; the Theory questions and the extension tasks.`,
        absent: `**Absentees and latecomers:** a catch-up page (the Notes and ${exLabel(0)}); a study buddy shares the exit-ticket answers; the Lesson 2 review recaps Lesson 1.`,
        behaviour: '**Learners who lose focus:** clear group roles and time limits; seat near the teacher; praise on-task behaviour; quick check-ins during group work.'
      };
      const sen = Object.keys(NEEDS).filter(k => ctx.need(k)).map(k => (ctx.count(k) && !/^\*\*[^*]*\(\d+\)/.test(SEN[k])) ? SEN[k].replace(':**', ` (${ctx.count(k)}):**`) : SEN[k]);
      out.push(B.p('**Learners with special educational needs, and inclusion (GESI)**', { before: 4, color: 'accent' }));
      out.push(B.ul(sen.length ? sen : ['No additional needs were selected. Keep the AP, P and HP tasks and watch for learners who need extra support.']));
      out.push(B.ul(['**Learners who finish early:** move to the next column (P to HP) instead of waiting.']));
      return out;
    }

    /* ---------- assessment */
    const prose = t => { const w = String(t).split(/\s+/); const words = w.filter(x => /^[A-Za-z][a-z’']{3,}[,.;:?]?$/.test(x)).length; const mathy = w.filter(x => /[=+×÷^√<>≤≥]|\d[a-z]|[a-z]\d/.test(x)).length; return words >= 8 && mathy / Math.max(1, w.length) < 0.25 && /^[A-Z“"(]/.test(String(t).trim()) && !/^[A-Za-z]?\d|^\(?[a-z]\s*[=+]/.test(String(t).trim()); };
    const tmItems = (tm.assess || []).filter(a => !a.exam).flatMap(a => a.items.map(it => ({ ...it, title: a.title }))).filter(it => it.clean && len(it.text) > 40 && prose(it.text) && it.parts.every(p => p.t.length < 300) && !/\b(below|above|diagram|figure|graph shown|table below|shown|following data|this shape|the net)\b/i.test(it.text + it.parts.map(p => p.t).join(' ')));

          q: it.text + (parts ? ' ' + it.parts.map((p, i) => `(${'abcdefgh'[i]}) ${p.t}${p.marks ? ` [${p.marks}]` : ''}`).join(' ') : ''),

        pool.push({ src: 'th', sec: 'B', t: Math.max(8, Math.min(14, 5 + steps.length * 2)), m, dok: Math.max(3, dokOf(t.q)) === 4 ? 4 : 3, pri: q === 0 ? 1 : 2, q: `${t.q} (Theory ${k + 1})`,

          steps: steps.length > 1 ? steps.slice(0, 6).map(x => endDot(clip(x, 2, 300))).concat(t.answer ? [`**Answer:** ${t.answer}`] : []) : null });
      });

      let usedT = 0; const pick = [];

      const allQ = P.quiz.map((_, q) => q), allE = P.exercise.map((_, q) => q), allT = P.theory.map((_, q) => q);
      const freshQ = allQ.filter(q => !used.quiz.has(q)), freshE = allE.filter(q => !used.exer.has(q)), freshT = allT.filter(q => !used.th.has(q));

(() => { const t = P.theory[it.q]; const st = (t.steps || []).map(stepStr).filter(Boolean); const fin = st.filter(x => !/^\s*(\([a-z]\)\s*)?check\b/i.test(x)); return t.answer ? endDot(t.answer) : fin.length ? endDot(clip(fin[fin.length - 1], 2, 260)) : st.length ? endDot(clip(st[st.length - 1], 1, 220)) : 'See the model answer in the Learner Material.'; })() : `${quizBits(it.q).ans}.`;
      const blocks = [];

[exitQ + 1] : []))}` : ''}${items.some(x => x.t === 'T') ? `; Theory ${numList(items.filter(x => x.t === 'T').map(x => x.q + 1))}` : ''}${exIdx != null ? `; ${exLabel(exIdx)}` : ''}). It revisits this week's indicators; it adds no new content.`,
